items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanse that won't strip skin that looks dry.
Ceramide moisturizer to support comfort and hydration for skin with a low moisture score.
Tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides helps protect against visible tone changes and evens the look of dark patches.

response.routine_note: Please have a dermatologist look at the mole on your cheek soon, since a mole that has grown and darkened is something a shop can't assess, and hold off on brightening actives until then. In the meantime, cleanse gently, moisturize, and wear the SPF every morning.
